chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 48: Metamorphosis and Lost Treasure
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen witnesses a treefolk's metamorphosis into human form and discovers a pool of life nectar, but Keke's gluttony leaves him with only crystals. A chapter of wonder and frustration.
og_title: World of Immortality - Ch 48: Metamorphosis & Waste
og_description: In Treefolk Valley, Xiao Chen sees an elder treefolk transform into a human and finds a nearly drained pool of life nectar—wasted by the gluttonous little beast. Wonder and regret intertwine.

twitter_description: Xiao Chen discovers life nectar and a metamorphosing treefolk, but Keke has already consumed most of the treasure. A chapter of awe and missed opportunity.
